name: AnimatedPadding
description: A widget that automatically animates changes in its padding over a given duration and curve. Useful for smoothly adjusting spacing around a child widget without a StatefulWidget.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree whose padding will be animated.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: The target padding around the child.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate padding changes.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating the padding changes.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeInOut, Curves.bounceIn
